continuous_scalability.problem: Previous subtitle/label rich-text retention used a binary threshold derived from GlobalQualityWeight.
continuous_scalability.solution: BabelRichTextLodPolicy computes retention = saturate(lerp(0.16, 1.0, smoothstep(GlobalQualityWeight))) and compares a stable per-text 16-bit hash threshold to retention.
continuous_scalability.low: At GlobalQualityWeight 0, about 16 percent of localized rich styling is retained by stable text hash; all labels remain legible and TMP parsing stays enabled.
continuous_scalability.middle: Between 0 and 1, retention increases continuously; workload scales by aggregate retained style density rather than binary device class.
continuous_scalability.high: At GlobalQualityWeight 1, retention reaches 100 percent; saved budget can be spent on richer presentation without changing DTO/text ownership.
continuous_scalability.ultra: No gameplay truth, locale identity, or subtitle DTO layout changes with quality; only presentation styling density changes.

cursor_and_truncation_proof.decode_utf8_visual_span: For every decoded scalar, writes occur only when charCursor < maxGlyphs for BMP or charCursor + 1 < maxGlyphs for surrogate pairs. length is assigned from charCursor, and AppendEllipsis receives maxGlyphs, so cursor cannot exceed destination.Length.
cursor_and_truncation_proof.pda_decrypt_label: writeLength = min(length, sourceCapacity, CharBufferPool.SlotCapacity). Both source and destination spans are sliced to writeLength; Scramble loops i < source.Length. SetCharArray uses the same writeLength. Lease release is in finally.
cursor_and_truncation_proof.localized_world_sign: displayLength is clamped to sourceBuffer.Length before copy. EnsureBuffer only runs when persistent sign buffer capacity is insufficient; no manual RTL copy is performed.
